description: Manifest of all EduSphere tables containing Personally Identifiable Information (PII). Used by GDPR Art.20 export attestation and Art.17 erasure verification.

tables.name: users
tables.note: Primary definition in core.ts; also re-exported from users.ts (base subset)

tables.name: users_base
tables.note: Base users table definition — same DB table as 'users' in core.ts

tables.name: agent_sessions
tables.note: Session metadata may contain user-provided context

tables.name: agent_messages
tables.note: Free-text conversation content with AI agents

tables.name: user_courses
tables.note: Enrollment records linked to user identity

tables.name: user_consents
tables.note: Consent records include IP and browser fingerprint

tables.name: quiz_results
tables.note: Assessment answers and scores linked to user

tables.name: peer_review_assignments
tables.note: Peer review text authored by learners

tables.name: push_notification_tokens
tables.note: Device push tokens are device-level PII

tables.name: saved_searches
tables.note: Search queries may reveal personal interests

tables.name: onboarding_state
tables.note: Onboarding wizard data may contain user preferences

tables.name: audit_log
tables.note: Audit trail — IP addresses and browser fingerprints

tables.name: notification_deliveries
tables.note: Notification content may include user names and personal context

tables.name: user_whatsapp_contacts
tables.note: Encrypted phone numbers (SI-3) and OTP verification hashes
